tagline: 柯尼卡取景器相机，1987 年发布
description: 柯尼卡于1987年推出的取景器相机。配备Konica Lens 35mm F4 (4 elements in 4 groups)。快门速度Mechanical shutter, 1/125 sec. (fixed speed)。使用Manual advance (thumb-cog) and rewind。感光度ISO 100/200/400 (manual setting)。Focus free (fixed focus), 1.1 m - infinity。

specs.镜头: Konica Lens 35mm F4 (4 elements in 4 groups)
specs.曝光测光: Fixed exposure; an aperture is selected according to the film speed.
specs.英文简介: The Konica Manbow is a compact camera introduced by the Japanese manufacturer Konica as their first weatherproof camera in 1987.
